quarterly_data.signal: S.Y. Hsu (author of the company blog post on his visit to NTUST): ASUS has moved 'from PCs to a full AI stack spanning infrastructure, devices, and applications'; 'Our server business has grown more than 5x' (no period stated). He adds that Taiwan has stood up eight of the world's AI supercomputers on the Top 500 list and 'ASUS led five of them' (company claim).
